newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BANKING STOCKS FIGHT OFF DOWNWARD TREND.
newsitem.headline: BANKING STOCKS FIGHT OFF DOWNWARD TREND.

text.p: * Total trade at 71.4 million kroons vs 99.1 million kroons.
* Index 1.89 percent higher to 352.07.
* 28 stocks traded: 13 down, 9 up, 6 steady.
* Hoiupank was the most active with 15.1 million
kroons traded to close 5.75 kroons higher at 213.75 kroons.
* Hansapank also turned over 15.1 million kroons
to gain 4.75 kroons kroons to 195.50 kroons.
Hoiupank resisted the fall in
prices on Wednesday and propped Hansapank up as well, dealers
said.
"Hoiupank is still strong and investors don't think that
Hansapank can stand still or fall with Hoiupank holding buyers'
interest," one dealer said.
Total trade on the main list was 48.1 million kroons with
the Talse 1.89 percent higher to close at 352.07.
Hoiupank gained the most during the day to close at 213.75
kroons, up 5.75 kroons after turning over 15.1 million kroons.
"Hoiupank could still go a little higher and it may do that
again tomorrow," one trader said.
Hansapank followed Hoiupank with 15.1 million kroons traded
to be 4.75 kroons higher to close at 195.75 kroons.
"It seems that Hansapank is trying to find a new level as
it stayed between 190-195 kroons during the day," one trader
said.
"I don't see Hansapank going above 195 kroons or falling
below 190," he added.
On the free market, 23.3 million kroons changed hands with
Norma, an automotive safety belt manufacturer, the most active
stock.
Norma lost 1.33 kroons to close at 87.17 kroons after trade
of 11.8 million kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202,
reuters@reuters.ee
